title: Special offer discount
body: Hello, I want to address this issue clearly. I am an old customer. This app displayed a “30% off” promotion without stating that it was only for first-time subscribers. Otherwise, it becomes misleading advertising. After I contacted the customer service they telling me to “refer to the actual price” and to contact Apple for a refund and unsubscribe if I don’t need it. Of course I need it to watch the movie but I want to point out there misleading offers displayed. This is not an appropriate response to a customer who was misled by unclear information. A professional company should acknowledge the lack of clarity, take responsibility, and ensure the promotion is accurately communicated. I hope you take this feedback seriously and correct the wording of your promotions so future customers are not confused or charged unexpectedly. Thank you.
